    left to you: allow tcp from 172.16.0.0/12 to 10.77.0.10 ports 22,8080,8090, and nothing else to the VM
 9. Monitor
    the health URL for a monitor is https://code.example.com/__devbox/health
10. Verify
    ask https://code.example.com/__devbox/health through the public path, as a browser would

Everything is already up to date.

Your devbox

  Editor       https://code.example.com
  Agents app   https://agents.example.com
  SSH          ssh devbox

On each of your computers (macOS or Linux), once:

  curl -fsSL https://devbox.example.com/setup | sh

It installs a small client, asks for the password of the agents app to pair the computer's
key, and writes one block of SSH config. After that `ssh devbox` works from anywhere and wakes
the VM. Paired computers: `devbox ssh keys`.

On your phone: open https://agents.example.com in Safari, Share → Add to Home Screen, open it from
there, then Settings → Enable notifications.
